If your toddler is currently living off pasta, bread, and rice… this one’s a win 🙌   It’s creamy, cheesy, packed with protein and has spinach (they won’t even notice 👀) 🧀 Creamy Turkey Ricotta Pasta Ingredients: - 1 cup pasta (well cooked) - ¼ of a 1.5 lb package ground turkey   - 1–2 cloves garlic, finely minced   - ½ cup milk   - ½ cup ricotta cheese   - ¼–½ cup shredded mozzarella   - 1 tbsp olive oil or butter   - Finely chopped spinach   👩‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Cook pasta until soft. Drain and set aside.   2. In a pan, heat oil/butter and add garlic. Cook ~30 seconds.   3. Add ground turkey and cook, breaking into small pieces, and add Italian seasoning. 4. Lower heat, pour in milk and stir.   5. Add ricotta and mix until creamy.   6. Add spinach and cook. 7. Add cooked pasta and mix well.   8. Stir in mozzarella until melted and creamy. Add a splash of milk if needed.   9. Cool slightly and serve! #toddlerrecipes #toddlerdinner #toddlermealideas #easyrecipe
